_meta.description: Per-crew-member-per-sol life-support inputs. Values marked verified:true are NASA BVAD nominal values; fields marked verified:false are deliberately retained gameplay assumptions until a mission-specific NASA source and derivation are selected.
_meta.how_to_fill: Use NASA/TP-2015-218570/REV1. Table 3-33 (PDF p. 76; printed p. 63) supplies nominal O2, CO2, food mass, and potable-water values. Table 4-57 (PDF p. 135; printed p. 122) supplies the nominal dry-food mass used by this contract.

o2_consumption_kg_per_person_per_day.source: NASA/TP-2015-218570/REV1, Table 3-33, PDF p. 76 (printed p. 63): nominal O2 consumed, kg/CM-d.

co2_production_kg_per_person_per_day.source: NASA/TP-2015-218570/REV1, Table 3-33, PDF p. 76 (printed p. 63): nominal carbon dioxide load, kg/CM-d.

potable_water_consumption_l_per_person_p.source: NASA/TP-2015-218570/REV1, Table 3-33, PDF p. 76 (printed p. 63): nominal potable water consumed, 2.5 kg/CM-d; modeled as 2.5 L/CM-d.

hygiene_water_consumption_l_per_person_p.source: No fixed BVAD nominal value selected: hygiene loads are mission dependent. Kept at zero so the model does not add an unsupported separate draw to the Table 3-33 potable-water baseline.

water_recycling_efficiency_pct.source: NASA Environmental Control and Life Support Systems reference, updated 2025-04-04: ISS Water Recovery System recovers and recycles about 90 percent of station water. Applied here as a whole-loop proxy, not as a lunar-outpost hardware prediction.

food_consumption_kg_dry_per_person_per_d.source: NASA/TP-2015-218570/REV1, Table 4-57, PDF p. 135 (printed p. 122): nominal IVA food dry mass, kg/CM-d.

power_baseline_kw_per_person.source: Gameplay assumption pending a mission-specific NASA power-system architecture and allocation.
